Write $987654321=10^9-12345679$. Since $12345679\cdot9=111111111$ and $123456789=9\cdot13717421$,
\[123456789\cdot12345679=13717421\cdot111111111=\dfrac{13717421\left(10^9-1\right)}{9}=\dfrac{13717420986282579}{9}=1524157887364731.\]
Therefore
\[123456789\times987654321=123456789000000000-1524157887364731=\boxed{121932631112635269}.\]
